release_notes:
- Deduplicator now also finds duplicates inside the same database (SPORTDiscus, for example, often returns the same article twice), and you can analyse a single library on its own.
- Deduplicator no longer skips part of the matching in large libraries: with more than a few hundred records, many near-identical titles (a typo, a plural, 2019 vs 2020) used to go unnoticed.
- Deduplicator no longer merges different papers that share the start of their title, such as two articles with different subtitles or different DOIs.
- Deduplicator: the "Exact groups" card now counts every group matched by DOI or PMID, and each new analysis shows only its own groups.
- PRISMA: "Records excluded" now counts the records you actually excluded at title/abstract screening, not every record still waiting for a decision. "Load from DB" tells you how many records are still undecided.
- PRISMA now shows the numbers of the project you are working on as soon as you switch projects.
- Records imported from SPORTDiscus or CINAHL no longer get EBSCO's record number as a PubMed ID, which made "Metadata" fill in details from an unrelated article. Records already imported are fixed automatically.
- Smart Classificator explains each design in a new "Why" column, and recognises more designs by asking whether the investigators assigned the intervention, at random or not, and when they measured.
- New "Ask AI about N doubtful records" button in Smart Classificator: the AI reads the title and abstract of the records the rules are unsure about and quotes the sentence it relies on. Each record is only paid for once.
- Smart Classificator clears its preview when you switch projects.
